description:
Paid training starting 2 December and 14 December
Hybrid working after 3 months on-site, subject to performance
Career development within a leading global CX company
Full-time position in Bucharest


Requirements

A leading global CX company is hiring Technical Support Specialists (German) for a well-known consumer electronics / home appliance brand, based in Bucharest, Romania.
Responsibilities:
Provide first-line technical support to customers in German by phone, email and chat
Troubleshoot product and usage issues and guide customers to a resolution
Log and document every interaction accurately in internal tools
Work to quality, productivity and customer satisfaction targets
Vacancies: 2-3. Training cohorts start on 2 December and 14 December. Full time. First 3 months fully on-site in Bucharest, then hybrid subject to performance.

Benefits

German at C1 level is mandatory (support is provided in German only)
English at B1 level is sufficient (used for internal tools only)
Customer-service or technical-support mindset and good computer literacy
Ability to work on-site in Bucharest for the first 3 months
Full-time availability
